summary: This class explores the custom of reciting the blessing before or after lighting Shabbat candles according to various rabbinic authorities and traditions. It details views from the Rambam, Rema, Maran, and Middle Eastern communities, including specific customs practiced in Halab. It also discusses halachic considerations regarding candle lighting and accepting Shabbat.
subjects: Hacham Ezra Attieh and Hacham Ovadia Yosef
questions: Should the blessing on Shabbat candles be recited before or after lighting?
What are the sources regarding when to recite the blessing on Shabbat candles?
What were the different practices regarding candle lighting in Halab?
How does lighting candles relate to accepting Shabbat according to Maran?
